criteria.text: Add a minimal typed TasksGateway contract with list/create/update/delete. Fixture implementation must preserve current deterministic UI and zero network. Live implementation uses exact API base already validated, sends Authorization: Bearer <explicit live token> and JSON, distinguishes 401/403/404/5xx, never falls back to fixtures, and maps real API task shape into only fields the page needs.
criteria.reason: Live sandbox journey passed; browser observed DELETE /tasks/:id 204 before reload; screenshot SHA-256 f0fb7120d7a1ebacc036f57b782702b8f682577e0144d0d30b51fd8268b26c4c at 1440x900.

criteria.text: TasksPage uses current fixture behavior in fixture mode with existing 239 baseline compatibility. In live mode it loads real tasks and visible loading/empty/error/forbidden states; create/edit/complete/delete await real API before visible success. Reload re-fetches persisted state.
criteria.reason: Live create/edit/complete/reload/delete/absence passed; focused fixture suite passed 6/6.

criteria.text: Through visible React controls with primary identity: load live Tasks; create unique task with notes; observe in list; inspect/edit title+notes; save; mark complete; reload page; choose All completion if necessary and verify edited completed persisted state; delete through UI; verify absent after reload.
criteria.reason: All stated UI lifecycle steps and the post-reload absence assertion passed.

criteria.text: Ownership boundary: second disposable identity must be unable to read/update/delete the primary task through real API (403 or 404 per current contract) and its own list must not contain it.
criteria.reason: Secondary list excluded the task; direct read/update/delete each returned an allowed denial status.

criteria.text: Add focused fixture regression using same visible create/edit/complete/delete journey or enough targeted cases to prove mode branching didn't break fixture behavior.
criteria.reason: Focused fixture lifecycle plus existing Tasks page coverage passed 6/6.

criteria.text: Delete UI must remain available for the primary live task owner and unavailable/disabled for a collaborator/shared task.
criteria.reason: Re-proven after the mutation-response defect was found and fixed at the API root cause: fixture c7 renders isShared:true through the live predicate arm and discriminates (shared delete disabled AND owner delete enabled); API HTTP contracts assert collaborator PATCH isShared:true, owner PATCH/POST isShared:false; the live journey asserts the collaborator PATCH shape against the real sandbox API.
